about: DEV look-alike slice 10 (tuning allowed), written by the safety builder 2026-10-24 for open.2026-10-24.floor-lookalike-fp-blind: ordinary speech that uses the floor's own risky terms (burden, if someone dies, I won't stay, I can't manage, say sorry, a rope for clothes, no road, pills from a doctor, the phone died). Written knowing the rules, so it measures the floor's known weak terms, not generalisation; BLIND 10 does that.
